name: Cap nach pork
summary: Lợn cắp nách is the local pork the national Sa Pa piece says is cooked in many ways. The piece does not list those ways.
origin: The national Sa Pa article, beside rượu táo mèo, rượu ngô, and the salmon plates. Provincial listings also name it at Cá Hồi Vua, Anh Dũng, and Quý Bếp.
howToEat: The article says many preparations and does not name them. Check on arrival.
Quý Bếp prints a mẹt of six dishes and does not name the six. Anh Dũng prints lợn mẹt đủ món at 1,000,000 đồng, beside an average of 1,000,000 đồng a person.
In Mai Châu, the Phú Thọ tourism list names lợn cắp nách as its own item, beside lợn mán. A method is Check on arrival.

In the Hà Giang highlands, the pig is small and free-range, about 4 to 10 kg, carried to market under the arm and raised on corn, sweet potato, cassava, roots, and forest greens. It is roasted whole, grilled in a bamboo tube, or steamed, with lòng dồi and rib-on belly dipped in salt pounded with green chili and mắc khén, for crisp skin, little fat, and firm lean meat. Drink rượu ngô or rượu táo mèo with it.
where: No single stall. Cá Hồi Vua at 015A Lê Văn Tám, Anh Dũng at 06 Xuân Viên, and Quý Bếp at 009 Lương Định Của each name the pork.
